ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 85:15 white-to-black pixel distribution; high-contrast boundary between central white field and black peripheral edges.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central contiguous white field covering ~80% of ventral surface; black perimeter banding extending from the median notch to distal tips; discrete dark circular focal markers located on the mid-left lobe and mid-right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch; interior angle approx 52 degrees; notch depth is approx 22% of the vertical fluke span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations; peak-to-valley amplitude varies between 5-15 pixels; significant jagged indentations on the medial portion of the right lobe trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex posterior lobes tapering to acute, upward-pointing distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small, high-contrast greyish-white clusters localized on the extreme distal tips (likely barnacle colonization).

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent irregular tissue loss/jagged indentation on the inner trailing edge of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique circular ring-shaped scar visible on the mid-left lobe surface; distinct dark focal spot on the mid-right lobe.
